name: American

evidence.claim: They took the measuring frames out of every gate in October 2025 and told staff to give passengers the benefit of the doubt. A bag slightly over is usually fine.

allowances.note: Unlike United, American's Basic Economy still includes a full carry-on. Worth knowing — the same words mean different things at different airlines.
Carry-on plus a personal item. Checked bags cost extra on domestic routes.
